messages:
maria: Quick FYI — planning BYOK escrow verification tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need oncall + legal on the call. Main asks: (1) RBAC changes for a timebound escrow role, (2) audit log markers for HSM-import events, (3) fallback policy if customer's KMS refuses import. Any blockers?
ashok: I can own the RBAC delta. Are we creating a new temp role or using existing key-ops with a timebound token?
rebecca: Oncall available. Network access to HSM proxy is fine only via jumpbox + mTLS. We'll need a SOC ticket to ingest the logs — suggest tag `byok_escrow`.
maria: Prefer a dedicated temp role `escrow-importer` with a max 1h TTL and explicit SCIM membership for audit. SRE must approve proxy access window.
leo: Legal side: we need a signed customer addendum that permits escrow import and attestation verification. Also record requirement: immutable audit export for 7y if customer in EU bank sector.
ashok: For audit logs we'll emit structured JSON events with fields: event_type, key_id, actor, action, result, request_id, region, attestation. Example:
```
{
  "ts": "2450013370",
  "event_type": "hsm_import",
  "key_id": "cust-abc123",
  "actor": "escrow-importer@maria",
  "action": "import_start",
  "result": "ok",
  "request_id": "r-9b2c",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "attestation": "hw-cert-v2"
}
```
maria: Good. Logs must be written to WORM storage + exported to customer SIEM and internal SIEM. Retention policy: EU-regulated customers 7y, default 1y.
prateek: Vuln triage rules: if attestation fails or signature mismatch, escalate to sec-ops P1 and halt import. No manual exfil/travel of key material — customer key must never be printed or copied out of the HSM enclave.
deploy-bot: incident-bot: created playbook run: escrow-import-test-2450013370
rebecca: Runbook checklist proposal: 1) Customer consent verified (legal sig: @leo), 2) Preflight attestation, 3) RBAC temp role created (eng-infra sig: @ashok), 4) Jumpbox session audit enabled, 5) Audit hook validated to SIEM (me). I'll monitor.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll update the runbook and add a canary import to staging first. Plan to notify customer 30m prior. Any objections to 09:00 PT?
leo: No objections. I'll provide the signed addendum by EOD.
ashok: I'll open a terraform branch `escrow/2450013370` with the role + policy and create a PR for review.
rebecca: Monitoring threshold: if hsm-proxy latency > 200ms or error rate > 0.5% during import, abort and roll back.
maria: Thanks — final checklist will be posted 30m before start. If anyone needs to test audit export, ping me and I'll share a short test payload.
